1. The Problem We Solve

  • • Human Emotion: Fear and FOMO cause retail traders to buy tops and panic-sell bottoms.
  • • Overfitting & Selection Bias: Testing on the same window used to pick assets produces misleading results.
  • • Unchecked LLM Hallucinations: Relying on unconstrained LLMs without fail-closed schema gates risks account blowup.

2. How Our System Works

  • • 4 Independent Strategies: Donchian Momentum, Bollinger/RSI Mean Reversion, StatArb Pairs, & Basis Yield.
  • • Dynamic Strategy Registry: Coordinator dynamically registers, enables, and manages N strategies.
  • • Strict Out-of-Sample: Universe frozen on Window 1; tested over non-overlapping Window 2 under Taker costs.

3. Unbreakable Safety Guarantees

  • • Drawdown Circuit Breaker: Blocks new position entries across the trading system when the configured portfolio risk threshold is reached.
  • • Persistent Peak Equity: Preserves high-water mark across daemon restarts without resetting risk memory.
  • • Mandatory Human Approval: Validated changes require explicit human authorization before updating active config.

SLIDE 2 OF 8 • THE BIG PICTURE

The Journey from Market Data to Protected Execution

Every 60 seconds, market prices pass through a 5-stage safety funnel before a single virtual dollar is committed.
STAGE 1 • SENSORS
Watch Markets
Fetches closed 1h candles from Binance & Yahoo Finance, plus CBOE VIX, FRED credit spreads, Polymarket odds, & SEC EDGAR filings.
STAGE 2 • PLAYBOOKS
Propose Trade
4 deterministic math strategies scan for trend breakouts (Momentum), oversold bounces (Mean Reversion), Pairs, or Basis Yield.
STAGE 3 • ARBITER
Filter & Veto
Coordinator & 5 Skill Gates block trades in bear trends (<200 EMA), sideways chop, NYSE opening bell gaps, or adverse SEC 8-K events.
STAGE 4 • SHIELD
Size Risk [1%–5%]
Risk Engine sizes units by volatility (ATR), caps concurrent crypto to 2 positions, checks spread/staleness, & runs 0.46s AI news check.
STAGE 5 • VAULT
Paper Fill & Learn
Atomically records the simulated fill in paper_portfolio.json, manages break-even & 50% scale-outs, and logs to Decision Journal.
Why This 5-Stage Funnel Matters in Plain English: Most automated bots jump straight from Stage 2 (Signal) to Stage 5 (Execution)—which is why they get wiped out during market crashes or earnings shocks. In our desk, Stages 3 and 4 act as an institutional safety firewall that blocked 408 hazardous trade setups across our 180-day replay.

SLIDE 4 OF 8 • HOW THE SYSTEM WORKS IN ACTION

Inside a 60-Second Tick: How a Trade Decision Is Reached

When strategies disagree, the system stays in cash. When they agree, the trade still has to survive 6 automated safety checks.

1. Signal Arbitration & Ranking

  • • Relative Strength Priority: Assets are sorted by 24-bar outperformance vs. BTC/SPY so strongest leaders get capital first.
  • • Conflict Cancellation: If Momentum says BUY while Mean Reversion says SELL, both cancel out and the bot stays in safe cash.

2. Regime & Institutional Gates

  • • Regime Routing: Below 200 EMA blocks Long breakouts; low ADX (<20) routes to Mean Reversion; strong trend (ADX ≥25) suppresses counter-trend trades.
  • • Wall Street Compliance: Blocks first 15m after 9:30 AM NYSE bell, SEC 8-K distress events, insolvent 10-Q XBRL balance sheets, and 30d wash sales.

3. Pre-Flight & 0.46s AI Veto

  • • Microstructure Check: Verifies quote staleness (≤180s), bid-ask spread (≤0.15%), and hourly volume participation (≤2%).
  • • Local LLM Devil's Advocate: Queries local phi4-mini on recent headlines (measured 0.46s latency in live logs) to veto black-swan news.

4. Automated Position Lifecycle: How Profits Are Banked & Losses Contained

Step A — Volatility Entry Sizing: Units are sized by ATR distance so hitting the initial stop-loss loses only 1% to 2% of portfolio equity (hard-capped at 5%).
Step B — Break-Even Stop Lock (+1.2x ATR): Once unrealized profit reaches +1.2x ATR, the stop-loss automatically moves above entry price to eliminate loss risk.
Step C — 50% Scale-Out & Chandelier Ratchet: At +2.0x ATR (or Bollinger SMA), 50% of the position is banked into cash and the rest trails tightly at +3R/+5R/+8R.

SLIDE 5 OF 8 • THE MAIN BUILDING BLOCKS (WHAT • WHY • HOW)

The 5 Core Building Blocks in Plain English

Every major subsystem exists to solve a specific failure mode of traditional automated trading.
1. The 4 Playbooks
WHAT Momentum, Mean Reversion, Stat-Arb Pairs, & Basis Yield.
WHY Markets trend only ~30% of the time; we need bounce and passive yield engines for the other 70%.
HOW Uses strictly causal indicators (.shift(1)) with zero lookahead bias.
2. Skill Gatekeeper
WHAT 5 institutional compliance gates (NYSE, SEC 8-K/XBRL, 13F, Tax).
WHY Price charts alone cannot see bankruptcies, earnings restatements, or market holidays.
HOW Checks live SEC EDGAR filings and blocks repeat ticker losses (48h cooldown).
3. Hard Risk Shield
WHAT Centralized sizer & circuit breaker (core/risk_engine.py).
WHY Prevents any single bad trade or crypto crash from wiping out the portfolio.
HOW Hard-clamps risk to [1%, 5%] equity, caps crypto at 2 positions, & halts at 15% DD.
4. Paper Vault
WHAT Simulated account ledger (PaperAccount) & OS process lock.
WHY Guarantees $0 real money is ever risked and prevents dual-process file corruption.
HOW Enforces kernel fcntl lockfiles and atomic .tmp → .bak JSON saves.
5. Night-Shift Crew
WHAT Autonomous Agents 9, 10, 11, & 12 running in the background.
WHY Static watchlists decay; losing stocks must be quarantined and re-audited.
HOW Scans markets every 24h, audits every 15 trades, & requires 125/125 passing tests.
